Our nightly evaluation is flaky. evaluate() on the mail data set (8 spam,
8 ham and 3 phishing rows, the default test_fraction of 0.25) dies with
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero roughly one night in three, and simply
re-running it usually gets through. We don't pass a seed. My guess is that
recall() needs to return 0 when there is nothing to divide by.
